GENERAL SCIENCE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: GENERAL SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Nutrition in Animals ● Chemical and mechanical digestion of foods ● Adaptations ? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Nutrition in Animals ● Chemical and mechanical digestion of foods ● Adaptations .
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Nutrition in Animals ● Chemical and mechanical digestion of foods ● Adaptations .
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Nutrition in Animals ● Chemical and mechanical digestion of foods ● Adaptations .
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Nutrition in Animals ● Chemical and mechanical digestion of foods ● Adaptations .

2. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

3. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Only water vapour

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Microorganisms ● Types of microorganisms ● Mode of transmission and infections o? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Microorganisms ● Types of microorganisms ● Mode of transmission and infections o.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Microorganisms ● Types of microorganisms ● Mode of transmission and infections o.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Microorganisms ● Types of microorganisms ● Mode of transmission and infections o.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Microorganisms ● Types of microorganisms ● Mode of transmission and infections o.

5. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Milk souring
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Ice melting to water

6. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Overgrazing continuously

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Plant growth and development ● Concept of growth and development in plants ● See? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Plant growth and development ● Concept of growth and development in plants ● See.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Plant growth and development ● Concept of growth and development in plants ● See.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Plant growth and development ● Concept of growth and development in plants ● See.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Plant growth and development ● Concept of growth and development in plants ● See.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Respiration ● Aerobic and anaerobic respiration ● Respiratory substrates and res? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Respiration ● Aerobic and anaerobic respiration ● Respiratory substrates and res.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Respiration ● Aerobic and anaerobic respiration ● Respiratory substrates and res.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Respiration ● Aerobic and anaerobic respiration ● Respiratory substrates and res.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Respiration ● Aerobic and anaerobic respiration ● Respiratory substrates and res.

9. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

10. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 0 °C

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Microorganisms 2.0 Matter and Chemical Reactions 2.1 The Periodic Table 2.2 Chem? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Microorganisms 2.0 Matter and Chemical Reactions 2.1 The Periodic Table 2.2 Chem.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Microorganisms 2.0 Matter and Chemical Reactions 2.1 The Periodic Table 2.2 Chem.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Microorganisms 2.0 Matter and Chemical Reactions 2.1 The Periodic Table 2.2 Chem.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Microorganisms 2.0 Matter and Chemical Reactions 2.1 The Periodic Table 2.2 Chem.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying The Periodic Table Classification of the first twenty elements of the periodic t? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to The Periodic Table Classification of the first twenty elements of the periodic t.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on The Periodic Table Classification of the first twenty elements of the periodic t.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for The Periodic Table Classification of the first twenty elements of the periodic t.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about The Periodic Table Classification of the first twenty elements of the periodic t.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Turning effect of force ● Moments of a force at a point ● Moments of anti- paral and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Linear motion ● Terms used in linear motion ● Equations of linear motion , ● Exa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
